title: Unclogging Drip Irrigation Pipes
problem: Tiny holes in farm drip irrigation pipes get choked with salty white deposits, causing water to stop reaching plant roots.
idea: A troubleshooting guide for drip pipes. The farmer taps the problem he sees and gets a simple, safe fix. Strong cleaning like acid wash is done only with an expert.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What problem do you see?
widgets.intro: Tap what you see in the drip line.
widgets.question: In the drip system I see:

options.label: White salty crust on drippers
options.result: Salt deposits. Flush the lines and clean drippers. For acid washing, ask the Horticulture / Agriculture Officer or drip company technician to do it safely.
options.te: ఉప్పు పేరుకుపోయింది. పైపులు ఫ్లష్ చేయండి. ఆసిడ్ కడుగు నిపుణుల సమక్షంలోనే చేయాలి.
options.tip: Acid is dangerous. Children must never handle it.

options.label: Green slime inside pipes
options.result: Algae growth. Keep the water tank covered and flush the lines.
options.te: నాచు పెరిగింది. నీటి ట్యాంకు మూసి ఉంచి పైపులు ఫ్లష్ చేయండి.

options.label: Mud and sand in the filter
options.result: Dirty filter! Open and wash the filter. Do this every week.
options.te: ఫిల్టర్ మురికిగా ఉంది! తెరిచి కడగండి. ప్రతి వారం చేయండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Weekly Drip Care Checklist
widgets.intro: Tick what you did this week.

items.text: Opened pipe ends and flushed dirty water out
items.te: పైపు చివర్లు తెరిచి మురికి నీరు బయటకు పంపాం

bands.text: Excellent! Your drip system will last long.
Good. Finish the rest this week.
Pipes may choke soon. Start with the filter.

questions.q: What should be cleaned every week?
questions.why: A clean filter stops sand and mud from choking drippers.

questions.q: Who should do an acid wash?
options: An adult with an expert / technician, wearing safety gear
questions.why: Acid can burn skin and eyes. It needs expert guidance.

how: Take photos of choked drippers, the filter and pipe ends in our field.
Use Google Lens to learn what the white crust and green slime are.
Ask Gemini for simple, safe maintenance steps. Note which steps need an expert.
Make a troubleshooting poster in Canva: problem photo → simple fix.
Translate it to Telugu with Gemini.
Show the poster to the Horticulture Officer or drip technician to check before sharing.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Make a simple troubleshooting guide in English and Telugu for farmers whose drip irrigation pipes get blocked by salt, algae or sand. Give safe weekly care steps. Do not give acid doses; say acid cleaning must be done by an adult with the drip technician or Horticulture Officer, with gloves and goggles.
